name: fx-discovery
description: FX Discovery — market-triggered FX sales-intelligence engine. npm-workspace monorepo: packages/core, packages/pipeline, apps/web.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fx/core && npm run typecheck -w @fx/pipeline
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fx/core && npm run test -w @fx/pipeline
scripts.pipeline: npm run db:import && npm run analyse && npm run discover && npm run enrich-contacts && npm run enrich-decision-makers && npm run enrich-website-intel && npm run score && npm run dedup && npm run generate-drafts && npm run db:export
scripts.sync-web-data: mkdir -p apps/web/public/data && cp data/events.json data/leads.json apps/web/public/data/
